title: Start the five leaf services together
goal: The daemon boot pass spawned susi-paths, susi-error, susi-config, susi-sandbox and susi-native one at a time, waiting ~0.6 s for each port before the next (~3 s measured from supervisor.log on three hosts). Spawn every missing service first, then wait for and record each, keeping orphan adoption, foreign-holder observation, ownership verification and shutdown reaping unchanged.
